root_cause: REFERENCE_PASS_PAYLOAD_WRAPPER_MISMATCH: the archived trainer hashes the unwrapped control record, but the archived validator hashes dict(status="PASS", **control). The status wrapper belongs only to reference_control.json; all original event hashes, links, sequence, timestamps and candidate transitions are valid.

research_chain_scope.validation_chain_scope: Separate validator_attempt.json and validator.json artifacts; not research-chain events
research_chain_scope.archive_chain_scope: Separate FINALIZED.json, Git commits, and external additive amendment receipts; not research-chain events
research_chain_scope.timestamp_order_rule: Nondecreasing UTC-aware ISO 8601; duplicate timestamps allowed; never regress
research_chain_scope.sequence_rule: Zero-based contiguous integers in the exact predeclared candidate order
research_chain_scope.hash_rule: SHA256 of canonical event object excluding event_sha256; previous_sha256 is null at root and the previous event hash thereafter
research_chain_scope.canonical_json_rule: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False), UTF-8; JSONL line endings are outside the hash
research_chain_scope.reference_pass_record_rule: Hash the unwrapped F5 control candidate record, identical to the following candidate_result record; status=PASS belongs only to reference_control.json
research_chain_scope.amendment_rule: External repair artifacts only; never overwrite or add files to the original finalized target tree
